maddeler.e:
ننحجب (form VII)
# نَنْحَجِبُ (nanḥajibu) /nan.ħa.d͡ʒi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# نَنْحَجِبَ (nanḥajiba) /nan.ħa.d͡ʒi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# نَنْحَجِبْ (nanḥajib) /nan.ħa.d͡ʒib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
